about: Starter dictionary for the interleaved English line. Each G-code word gets one English word: subject first, then action (SPINFWD, COOLON). Values carry their unit as a prefix (RPM600, IPM25). 'long' is the default style; 'short' is the compact style. A code whose meaning differs between machine types has 'mill' and 'lathe' entries. Machine definition files can override any entry. machineOverrides keys are a brand ('haas') or a brand and machine type ('okuma.mill'); the more specific key wins.
